invariants.rationale: Parallelism is typically required to be positive for parallel processing to occur.
A non-null data list is needed for streaming and iteration logic in the method.
consumer is required to apply the foreach operation and must not be null.
Either data is not empty, or if empty, parallelism must still be positive - ensures parallelism is meaningful only if data is present.
It is common to bound parallelism by data size to prevent wasting threads or inefficiency; if data is empty, the check is trivially true.
